Rahul Gandhi launches 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' campaign, plans Parliament gherao

Rahul Gandhi has written to Congress leaders urging support for the 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' campaign, which he describes as addressing an "unprecedented crisis" faced by youth. Party leaders announced that Congress will stage a gherao of Parliament on August 9 as part of this campaign. The initiative aims to amplify student voices and concerns.
